name: iManage Work
description: iManage Work Connector for MCP securely connects governed iManage content to Claude. Replace custom integrations with one open protocol, keep documents in iManage without bulk exports or replication, and ensure permission-bound, auditable Claude access as your AI strategy evolves.

_published_faq.name: How do I add iManage Work to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add iManage Work to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cloudimanage.com/mcp/work. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the iManage Work MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: iManage Work lists 14 MCP tools, including download_document, fetch, get_container_children, get_document_profile, get_document_versions, get_libraries, get_recent_documents, get_recent_workspaces, get_rows_from_csv_document, get_user_information, get_workspace_profile, and get_workspace_templates.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to iManage Work?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to iManage Work in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does iManage Work MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: iManage Work requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
iManage Work is developed by iManage LLC. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
